notes: This contract selects the 2025 Requirements Lab save-control requirements exercised by Umbra's embedded development profile. It covers an untimed initiation baseline, one-outstanding-save invariant, per-federate begin/complete/failure control, federation completion/failure, abort, status response, and resignation failure boundary. A separate bounded three-member case holds an untimed request while constrained members are idle, invokes each constrained member directly before its ordinary Time Advance Grant once all constrained members have pending grants, and queues the non-time-constrained member only after the final constrained admission. That untimed path is limited to stable membership/role state and non-Flush-Queue grant dispatch; the paired timed-save contract separately traces bounded TAR/TARA/NMR/NMRA and strict-actual-FQR callback timing. Neither contract establishes pending-grant restore, role or resignation churn while awaiting admission, durable snapshot serialization, complete restore semantics, all-service save interlocks, protected review, package support, or conformance. Paired restore-control regressions save a live TSO interaction and its retraction record before proving state rollback, save a terminal retraction tombstone before proving its classification survives restore, save a logical-time/actual-lookahead window before proving post-save changes are discarded, and preserve one deferred lookahead-decrease target; those narrow restore behaviors are traced separately.
